product_metadata.title: Sleep Restoration All Seasons Queen/Full Size Comforter - Reversible -  Cooling, Lightweight Summer Down Comforter Alternative - Hotel Quality Bedding Comforters - Burgundy/Black
features: PERFECTLY PLUSH - The height of luxury and comfort awaits you with our lightweight queen and full size comforter. It's a duvet so soft, you'll feel like you're laying among the clouds.

YEAR-ROUND COMFORT - A bed comforter for all seasons is an exceptional way to stay cozy. Our extra fluffy comforter will keep you cool on hot summer nights and pleasantly warm on cold winter evenings.

DELUXE QUALITY - Make the duvet of your dreams a reality with this premium down alternative comforter. Each one is crafted with ultra-soft, breathable materials and durable hems stitched to perfection.
REVERSIBLE DESIGN - From white and grey, to navy blue and ivory, this full and queen size comforter comes in 8 different color combinations to transform any bedroom into an upscale sleep sanctuary.

EASY CARE - Regardless of whether you need your comforters queen size, king size, or twin size, they should be effortless to clean. All duvets from this collection are machine washable and dryer safe.
